predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Columbus Crew vs Inter Miami: Expected Goals, Defensive Absences & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Columbus Crew hold the clearer structural edge at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field against a defensively depleted Inter Miami side, making a home win or scoring draw the balanced regulation-time projection.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win / Draw anchored by Columbus's five-match winning run and Miami's missing left-side defenders (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS Yes supported by a 3.44 combined lambda and sub-30% clean-sheet rates (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Second-half Miami surge creating a 2:2 draw variance branch if Columbus fail to kill an early lead (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Depleted Miami backline faces rampant Crew attack at ScottsMiracle-Gro Field.

spf.comment: Retains both the primary 2:1 Columbus Crew victory against Miami's depleted defense and the 2:2 draw branch driven by Messi and Suarez, as Miami's 1.97 xG/match attack makes a single Home Win call less resilient.

over_under.comment: A 3.44 combined lambda and both clubs exceeding 72% Over 2.5 frequency across 2026 league play strongly support three or more goals.

btts.comment: Both attacks project above a 78% scoring probability while facing defenses with 27.3% (Columbus) and 15.2% (Inter Miami) clean-sheet rates.

score.comment: Columbus's 1.89 home lambda against Miami's compromised flanks favors a 2:1 win, with 2:2 capturing Miami's late-game elimination push.

goals.comment: Model probabilities peak at 3 goals (21.8%) and 4 goals (18.7%), matching open game states around the 3.44 total lambda.

bqc.comment: Columbus's 58.6% home first-half goal share points to an interval lead, with Miami's 62.1% second-half away scoring split making Win-Draw the key recovery fork.
